profile:
## James

**Identity & relationships:** James is John’s lifelong friend; they skateboarded together at age 10 and continue to support each other. He is close to his sister, mother, family, friends, and partner Samantha (girlfriend from September 3, 2022; they moved in together October 31).

**Work/studies & projects:** Tried programming in college; knows Python and C++, has built websites, mods, and games. Enjoys creating projects, storytelling, problem-solving, perseverance, and checking notebook goals off. Developed a childhood game idea, a Witcher 3-inspired virtual world, a Unity strategy game, a football simulator component, and released his first game in October 2022. Wants to make more games and try more genres. Took a gaming/programming course and began streaming games.

**Hobbies/opinions:** Passionate about gaming, especially Apex Legends, The Witcher 3, RPGs, strategy games, Civilization, Total War, Zelda, Cyberpunk 2077, and FIFA 23. Gaming relaxes him, inspires creativity, connects him with others, and helps during difficult times. Loves bowling, football, Liverpool, reading, nature walks, hiking, skateboarding, music, guitar (formerly), drums (learning in March 2022), cooking, travel, roller coasters, surfing, and extreme sports/rope jumping. Likes rock music, fantasy, pizza (especially pepperoni; also cheese and prosciutto), and collaboration.

**Pets/possessions:** Dogs Max (playful Labrador-like swimmer and frisbee catcher), Daisy (Labrador), and Ned (adopted from a Stamford shelter in April 2022). He trains and treats them as family; they enjoy walks, beaches, fields, and skateboarding. Gaming PC, keyboard, mouse, comfortable chair, new video card, Nintendo childhood system, notebooks, and books.

**Timeline:** Italy/Turkey/Mexico visits (including Italy in 2021); March–April 2022: gaming tournaments, projects, hikes, puppy adoption, and large project completion; May: volunteering and amusement park; June: football course and dog introductions; July: Toronto/Vancouver/possibly Nuuk trip, surfing and rope jump; August–September: Samantha relationship, cooking classes, streaming, Unity game completed; October: first game released, Cyberpunk 2077, moved in with Samantha; November: family road trip and animal sanctuary.

## John

**Identity & relationships:** John is James’s lifelong friend. He values siblings and family, teaches relatives coding, and wants a pet but had none as of November 2022 (cousin’s dog Luna).

**Work/studies & goals:** Refreshed HTML/CSS through a programming class, freelanced on a small-business website, blogged about coding, and made a mobile puzzle/exploration game planned for October 2022. Left an IT job after three years in August 2022 for values-aligned work. Wants to organize gaming tournaments/eSports, potentially work in nonprofits, and use technology to help people. Volunteered programming for a children-focused foundation, building an inventory/resources/donations app; became a volunteer game-development mentor, organized seminars, and collaborated on an online board game.

**Hobbies/opinions:** Video games relax him and relieve stress: CS:GO, Fortnite, Overwatch, RPGs, The Witcher 3, FIFA 23, and strategy games. Attended/organized tournaments, including charity events for a dog shelter, homeless people, and a children’s hospital. Enjoys chess (online, club, and tournaments), board/card games, metal detecting, nature/travel, movies with friends, reading, science fiction and fantasy (The Stormlight Archive, Kingkiller Chronicle, The Expanse), electronic/rock music, drums, and socializing. Likes Hawaiian pizza.

**Possessions/skills:** Gaming PC, powerful graphics card, headset/Sennheiser headphones, gaming chair, keyboard, Logitech mouse, gaming room/desk, books, and former drum kit. Skilled at coding, teaching, organizing, collaboration, and chess.

**Timeline:** March–April 2022: programming course, new friends, gaming convention, canyon trip, coding assignment; May: chari
